title: Red and Blue (Synthwave)
style: Dark 80s synthwave dance track, 120 BPM, driving pulsing bass arpeggios, gated reverb snare, retro analog synth leads, brooding minor-key melody, neon night chase atmosphere, action movie soundtrack energy, club-ready four-on-the-floor kick, cool breathy female vocal
negativeTags: country, twang, acoustic guitar, chiptune, modern pop
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Engine revs)
License and registration... on the dance floor

[Verse 1]
Chrome on the highway, mirror shades on
Midnight patrol till the break of dawn
You were speeding through the city like you owned the lane
Now the lights are in your rearview and they call your name

[Pre-Chorus]
Pull it over, pull it over
Hands up high, now move it closer

[Chorus]
Red and blue, red and blue
Flashing lights coming after you
Two wheels and a heartbeat thrill
You can run but the bass won't stand still
Red and blue, red and blue!

[Verse 2]
Leather and thunder, the throttle's my voice
Write you a ticket, you don't get a choice
Dancing over the limit, ninety on the floor
I'm the law of the night, and you're coming back for more

[Pre-Chorus]
Pull it over, pull it over
Hands up high, now move it closer

[Chorus]
Red and blue, red and blue
Flashing lights coming after you
Two wheels and a heartbeat thrill
You can run but the bass won't stand still
Red and blue, red and blue!

[Bridge]
Sirens on, sirens on
Chase it till the night is gone
Rev it up, rev it up
Never gonna let you off

[Drop]
(Siren) Red and blue!
(Engine revs) Pull it over!

[Outro]
You're free to go...
This time.
